fit: Freeze the parent. Use existing guarded runtime-balanced admitted TRAIN curriculum, including original/mirrored runtime positives. Standardize128features using all2074TRAIN rows. Each of12 explicitly reviewed blue-object background crops is a center. Radius is half its nearest red OR blue TRAIN-positive feature distance; omit zero-radius centers. Compact support max(0,1-distance_squared/radius_squared), correction=max over prototypes of support*max(0,center_blue_logit-center_background_logit+8). No gradient fitting, seed sweep or development calibration.
prediction: Only decrease blue/background conditional odds, transferring removed blue probability to background. Preserve red probability exactly and return original scores bit-for-bit when correction is zero. This cannot create a new blue acceptance. No new acceptance threshold.
training_gate: All supplied TRAIN-positive crops receive exactly zero correction; all12 reviewed prototype backgrounds become background argmax. Validate original model identity and complete guarded curriculum before development.
evaluation: Replay all existing TRAIN and repeated development scene proposals from frozen background/blend pipeline. Recompute base classifier predictions, reproduce original selected decisions, then compare correction on/off. Keep geometry, proposals, threshold0.8 and selection unchanged. Report per-target losses even if totals improve. No use of IMG examples for fitting, calibration or mining.
promotion_gate: No per-color TP loss or FP increase and no lost parent target on any panel, plus at least one development FP reduction. Only then consider single-pass export and Pi timing; offboard two-pass prototype feasibility is not a deployable runtime or measured speed.
